requirements.requirement: The system must produce identical composite scores for identical input payloads across multiple test runs.
The system must verify that changing a single measure value results in a deterministic and reproducible change in the composite score.
The system must validate that the composite score equals the weighted sum of input measures according to the configured fixed weights.
The system must confirm that weight configurations are applied exactly as defined without normalization drift or implicit redistribution.
The system must enforce that at least 3 input measures are provided, and reject inputs with fewer than 3 measures.
The system must raise a controlled error when input measures contain null or missing values required for scoring.
The system must handle inputs where optional measures are missing by excluding them from scoring without breaking execution.
The system must validate correct normalization of input measures when values are at minimum and maximum bounds.
The system must ensure that the composite score remains within the defined output range for all valid inputs.
The system must verify that input order of measures does not affect the resulting composite score.
The system must raise a deterministic error when weight configuration is missing or incomplete.
The system must validate that floating point precision does not introduce inconsistent results across repeated calculations.
